core_journeys.purpose: Browse the current week's menu (6 classic + 4 rotating flavors) and open flavor profile detail pages
core_journeys.expected_result: weekly menu with flavor cards and detail pages visible
core_journeys.failure_variant: menu section empty or API unavailable

core_journeys.purpose: Find a store by ZIP/city and open its store page with address, hours, and order options
core_journeys.expected_result: matching stores listed with address/hours; store detail page reachable
core_journeys.recovery_variant: no-results message with a route back to search

core_journeys.purpose: Build a pickup order: choose a store, add 4/6/12-pack boxes with flavor selections, and reach a cart with correct subtotal
core_journeys.expected_result: cart reflects selected boxes, flavors, and subtotal

core_journeys.purpose: Complete a delivery order through contact/address, time window, review, and simulated payment to a confirmation view
core_journeys.expected_result: confirmation view reflects requested choices and totals; no external charge occurs
core_journeys.failure_variant: invalid address or declined simulated payment
core_journeys.recovery_variant: inline validation or retryable payment outcome

core_journeys.purpose: Submit order forms with required fields empty and verify inline validation identifies what must be corrected
core_journeys.expected_result: inline validation messages identify missing fields

core_journeys.purpose: Search for an impossible term and verify a no-results message plus a route back to available content
core_journeys.expected_result: no-results message with safe return path

core_journeys.purpose: Open sign-in, registration, and password-recovery entry points and verify visible fields and guidance without submitting credentials or creating accounts
core_journeys.expected_result: auth shells render fields and guidance; no account, session, challenge, or mail is created

core_journeys.purpose: Open a non-existent deep link and verify a branded not-found view preserving primary navigation and a safe route back
core_journeys.expected_result: branded 404 with primary navigation and home route
